#!/bin/sh
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# Slurm resources:
#   -J HAICprep
#   -N 1
#   -n 16
#   -t 01:00:00
#   -p normal256
#   -o POI16.eo%j
#   -e POI16.eo%j

#flux: --job-name=HAICprep
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 16
#flux: -c 1
#flux: --time-limit=1h

# Omitted Slurm option: -p normal256 (partition)
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may run with different limits/priority or on different hardware (or be rejected by policy).

# Omitted Slurm options: -o/-e with %j token
# Slurm's %j token (job id) is not portable in Flux output/error directives.
# Performance implication: none, but logs may overwrite/collide unless you choose unique filenames.

ulimit -c 0
ulimit -s unlimited
hostname

. ~rodierq/DEV_57/MNH-PHYEX070-b95d84d7/conf/profile_mesonh-LXifort-R8I4-MNH-V5-6-2-ECRAD140-MPIAUTO-O2-HAIC

# Replace mpirun wrapper with flux-run for launching 16 ranks.
ln -sf ../01_prep_pgd/PGD.* .
ln -sf ~/SAVE/mesonh/PGD/pgd_guyane* .
ln -sf ~/SAVE/GRIB_KTEST/arome.FO.201505* .
ln -sf ~/SAVE/GRIB_KTEST/historic.20150529.00.lfi

touch pgd_guyane.02km50.04.des
touch historic.20150529.00.des

time flux run -n 16 -c 1 PREP_REAL_CASE${XYZ}

for i in 00 06 12 18 24; do
    cp PRE_REAL1.nam_$i PRE_REAL1.nam
    time flux run -n 16 -c 1 PREP_REAL_CASE${XYZ}
done

cd ../
./run_all_mesonh

reasons: The original Slurm job specified a partition (`-p normal256`) but the Flux resource section has no queue/partition selection; on sites where this affects eligibility/limits, scheduling behavior may differ or the job may be rejected.

#!/bin/sh
#SBATCH -J HAICprep
#SBATCH -N 1            # nodes number =NBP dans tosupcrc
#SBATCH -n 16           # CPUs number (on all nodes) =NBP*TPN dans tosupcrc
#SBATCH -o POI16.eo%j   #
#SBATCH -e POI16.eo%j   #
#SBATCH -t 01:00:00     # time limit
#SBATCH -p normal256

# Echo des commandes
ulimit -c 0
ulimit -s unlimited
# Nom de la machine
hostname 

. ~rodierq/DEV_57/MNH-PHYEX070-b95d84d7/conf/profile_mesonh-LXifort-R8I4-MNH-V5-6-2-ECRAD140-MPIAUTO-O2-HAIC

export MPIRUN='Mpirun -np 16'

ln -sf ../01_prep_pgd/PGD.* .
ln -sf ~/SAVE/mesonh/PGD/pgd_guyane* .
ln -sf ~/SAVE/GRIB_KTEST/arome.FO.201505* .
ln -sf ~/SAVE/GRIB_KTEST/historic.20150529.00.lfi

touch pgd_guyane.02km50.04.des
touch historic.20150529.00.des

time ${MPIRUN} PREP_REAL_CASE${XYZ}

for i in 00 06 12 18 24; do
    cp PRE_REAL1.nam_$i PRE_REAL1.nam
    time ${MPIRUN} PREP_REAL_CASE${XYZ}
done
cd ../
./run_all_mesonh
